title: AI内部轮动：资金从存储转向银行，防御板块能否持续受追捧？
speaker: Chris Weston

segments.en: Now, what we're seeing obviously is this idea of broadening a ownership, and people are looking not just within styles and factors, but within AI itself, so where do we want to go?
segments.zh: 现在我们看到的是持仓的分散化，人们不仅在风格和因子间调整，也在AI内部寻找方向。

segments.en: Do we want to come out of memory? Do we want to redistribute that into other areas of AI?
segments.zh: 是要撤出存储芯片？还是重新配置到AI的其他领域？

segments.en: Do we want to go more into banks, which has been a big trade recently, and now that people are starting to say, well, we want those strong cash flow businesses, we want the low beta businesses at the moment, and go a bit more defensive.
segments.zh: 还是更多配置银行板块？近期银行交易活跃，现在人们开始偏好现金流强劲、低波动的防御性业务。

segments.en: So there is a broadening out as we go into earnings season of ownership, and that what that means is people have been becoming more market weight in various parts of the AI spectrum of semis.
segments.zh: 随着财报季到来，持仓正在分散化，这意味着人们对AI半导体各子板块的配置更加接近市场权重。

segments.en: And therefore, I would say right now, if we were to see WTI crew pushing firmly above 80, if we were to see Brent pushing up into the 90s and volatility spiking, and then people
segments.zh: 因此，如果WTI原油突破80美元，布伦特原油升至90美元，波动率飙升，那么市场情绪可能进一步转变。
